DataPassport.title: DataPassport
DataPassport.description: Сводка оснований перед массовой посадкой; сама посадка здесь не проверяется.

DataPassportEntry.title: DataPassportEntry
DataPassportEntry.description:
Класс исходных данных и его участие в текущем расчёте.

Сообщаем только доказуемые сведения об исходнике и подготовке. Отсутствующий
слой не становится подтверждением отсутствия физических объектов.

DxfTextEncoding.title: DxfTextEncoding
DxfTextEncoding.description: Browser TextDecoder labels for codecs supported by the DXF reader.

GrowthEnvelopeForecast.title: GrowthEnvelopeForecast
GrowthEnvelopeForecast.description: A bounded biological forecast, never a regulatory exclusion zone.

GrowthForecastResponse.title: GrowthForecastResponse
GrowthForecastResponse.description: Временная проверка роста сохранённых посадок без изменения плана и его замечаний.

ImportMode.title: ImportMode
ImportMode.description:
How the current project's source was opened.

A plain DXF that contains Green Atlas planting layers is deliberately not
treated as an editable revision: without the release manifest those
circles are indistinguishable from existing vegetation.  A complete
release bundle carries the source and plan semantics needed to continue
editing safely.

message.title: Message
message.default: Исходный DXF доступен для подготовки редактируемого плана.

LiveCadReference.title: LiveCadReference
LiveCadReference.description: A reference traversed in memory, not a verified/archived package file.

LiveDocumentCapture.title: LiveDocumentCapture
LiveDocumentCapture.description: Disk identity is context, not proof that unsaved geometry matches it.

NativeAreaProposalReview.title: NativeAreaProposalReview
NativeAreaProposalReview.description: Small durable review record; the signed native preview stays in the source capture.

PlacementCheckRequest.title: PlacementCheckRequest
PlacementCheckRequest.description: The same candidate as Add, optionally bound to the caller's snapshot.

PlacementMaskRequest.title: PlacementMaskRequest
PlacementMaskRequest.description:
A repeatable, project-aware planting arrangement preset.

Masks describe an operator's spatial intent.  They only propose candidate
positions; the ordinary change-set preview remains the authority for every
statutory setback, occupied contour and plant-to-plant distance.

planning_horizon_year.title: Planning Horizon Year
planning_horizon_year.description: Историческое значение; прогноз роста задаётся отдельным сценарием

PlanChangeReceipt.title: PlanChangeReceipt
PlanChangeReceipt.description: Historical acknowledgement, without pretending it is the current plan.

PlanValidationBasis.title: PlanValidationBasis
PlanValidationBasis.description: Основание замечаний: версия плана, горизонт и идентичность расчётных данных.

ProjectRead.title: ProjectRead
ProjectRead.description: Runtime availability is returned to clients, never persisted as fact.

RegulatoryReleaseBasis.title: RegulatoryReleaseBasis
RegulatoryReleaseBasis.description:
Human-confirmed process basis attached to a final project revision.

This is deliberately not a claim that the service issued a permit.  It
makes the PP-616/PP-1160 decision explicit, attributable and auditable
before a package may be labelled final.

source_index.title: Source Index
source_index.description: Index among parsed nonempty geometries of obstacle_kind in this geometry revision

nearest_features.title: Nearest Features
nearest_features.description: Up to 20 equidistant nearest source features in original order

SceneContextFeature.title: SceneContextFeature
SceneContextFeature.description: A lightweight, honest DXF footprint used as the 3D ground reference.

SceneEvidence.title: SceneEvidence
SceneEvidence.description: Provenance and coverage are separate from whether a value exists.

SceneVerticalPrimitive.title: SceneVerticalPrimitive
SceneVerticalPrimitive.description: Source-proven XYZ translated only in XY into the scene frame.

TopologyRecipe.title: TopologyRecipe
TopologyRecipe.description: Выбор вспомогательных границ, привязанный к неизменяемому CAD-захвату.

UtilityContext.title: UtilityContext
UtilityContext.description: Explicit source interpretation; a layer-name guess is not confirmation.
